actions.action: Slide plant out of pot and check roots
Repot in spring into pot 2 inches wider with drainage and aroid mix
Flush soil with plain water to remove salt crust, monthly
Let top inch of soil dry between waterings (check soil)
Fertilize monthly with half-strength balanced fertilizer in spring/summer

reason: The answer blames root-binding and slow growth instead of multiple tangled trees, never suggests separating them, and its reassurance that nothing is seriously wrong, plus waiting until spring to repot, delays the actual fix.
